title: Evaluation of the drop-value vector
statement: Let $n,p,z,s,u,f,q,t,a$ be natural numbers, and form the length-nine vector $(p,n,z,s,u,f,q,t,a)$. For every index $r$ from $0$ to $8$, evaluating the vector at $r$ gives the corresponding entry.
